name: Noura
story_so_far: I arrived shipwrecked with a badly injured ankle, leaving me dependent on others. For days, Khalid was my only protector, promising to ensure I ate, but today he died from hunger and exhaustion. Faisal found a tiny bit of food today, but he is also injured with a twisted ankle. Salem is the only person capable of foraging, as Reem also twisted her ankle and can no longer help. I am now dangerously weak, my health has dropped to 2/10, and I have no food. My protector is dead, and I am terrified that the others will forget about me now that he isn't here to demand my share.

Faisal.note: He found a tiny bit of food, but he's injured and I don't know if I can rely on him.

Salem.note: He is the only one left who can actually find food, so my life depends on him.

Reem.note: She was my hope for food, but now she is injured and useless to me.

Khalid.note: He was the only one who truly cared, and his death has left me completely vulnerable.

plans: I will try to stay awake and alert to ensure Salem gives me my share of whatever he finds, because I cannot survive another night on an empty stomach.

diary.text: Today was exhausting and terrifying. I woke up on this beach feeling completely lost, but I managed to scavenge some wood so I don't starve later. Khalid seems to be trying to lead, which is fine as long as it works. I need to make sure I keep enough food for myself; I can't rely on these strangers to share fairly.

My ankle is throbbing and I feel so vulnerable. I spent the whole day stuck at camp while everyone else went off to find things. I've used up all my food, so I am officially dependent on the others now. I hope Khalid or Salem comes back with something, or I'll be in real trouble.

Another day of doing nothing while my ankle throbs. I am starting to feel lightheaded from hunger, and it is becoming harder to ignore the emptiness in my stomach. I watched Salem bring back one single piece of food, but he didn't offer any to me. I am terrified that if I don't get something to eat tomorrow, I won't have the strength to even speak to Khalid.

Today was a rollercoaster. I was terrified that my hunger would finally make me collapse, but Khalid actually listened to me and ensured I got something to eat. It's a relief to have a full stomach for once, even if it was just a small amount. However, seeing Khalid injured with his own twisted ankle makes me realize how precarious our situation is. If the leader can't walk, who is going to make sure I'm looked after tomorrow?

Another day of hunger, and my stomach is starting to ache again. Salem found a little bit of food this morning, but it clearly wasn't enough to share with everyone. With Khalid injured and Faisal and Reem out in the jungle, I feel more isolated than ever. I'm resting as much as I can, but I'm terrified of what happens if no one returns with a real meal tomorrow.

I am so dizzy I can barely keep my eyes open. Today was a nightmare; Faisal is now injured too, and there's no one left to hunt besides Salem and Reem. Khalid keeps promising to protect my share, but his own ankle is twisted, so I feel completely abandoned. If they don't bring back a real meal tomorrow, I don't think I'll have the strength to wake up.

I am so weak I can barely write this. My stomach feels like it's eating itself, and the dizziness won't stop. Salem found one tiny bit of food, but it wasn't enough to stop the shaking in my hands. Khalid keeps whispering sweet promises, but he's injured too, and I'm starting to wonder if anyone can actually save me. If Reem doesn't come back from the jungle with something substantial, I don't know if I'll have the strength to see tomorrow.

I am so alone. Khalid is gone... he died right here while trying to protect me, and now there is no one left to stand up for my share. My body feels like it is fading into nothing, and the hunger is a constant, gnawing pain. Reem and Faisal are both useless with their injuries, and Salem is the only one left who can move. If Salem doesn't bring back a feast tomorrow, I don't think I will wake up.
